summary: The prepared source still attempted diffusion QKNorm/RoPE and residual-gate JIT builds on pre-Ampere CUDA. Added an sm_80 minimum gate before either reported probe, while preserving ROCm behavior. Mocked sm_75 regression tests fail before and pass after; sm_80, sm_90, sm_121, and ROCm are independent boundaries.

tests.what_was_measured: The regression was absent: all 11 initial architecture-gate assertions failed. Raw output: reports/j-c8b06a37a35c/raw/failing_before.txt

12 tests passed: sm_75 rejection occurs before QKNorm loader or residual tensor inspection; sm_80/sm_90/sm_121 and ROCm remain accepted. Raw output: reports/j-c8b06a37a35c/raw/passing_after_unit_final.txt

On AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950, the gate remained enabled and the HIP JIT kernel executed. The existing bf16 bit-exact expectation differed by max_abs=0.03125. Raw output: reports/j-c8b06a37a35c/raw/gfx950_direct_check.txt

tests.command: SGLANG_JIT_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-c8b06a37a35c/jit-cache /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-c8b06a37a35c/venv/bin/python <gfx950 fp32 residual-gate vs CPU fp64 reference>
tests.what_was_measured: The real HIP JIT output matched an independent CPU float64 expression with max_abs=3.086158244514081e-07 and passed atol=rtol=1e-5. Raw output: reports/j-c8b06a37a35c/raw/gfx950_fp32_numerical.txt
All changed Python sources compiled successfully.
Environment limitation: the prepared interpreter does not contain the ruff module. Raw output: reports/j-c8b06a37a35c/raw/ruff.txt

gpu_execution_evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950, torch capability tuple 9.5, ROCm 7.2) executed the residual-gate HIP JIT kernel; see reports/j-c8b06a37a35c/raw/gfx950_direct_check.txt and gfx950_fp32_numerical.txt.
remaining_limitations: No NVIDIA sm_75 GPU, CUDA 13 pip toolkit, or nvcc was available, so the reported glibc/CUDA CRT rsqrt compiler diagnostic and 49-second Flux latency were not reproduced directly.
FLUX.2-klein-4B weights were unavailable; no full diffusion-model generation or semantic-quality claim is made.

The fix is therefore candidate_verified through actual source control flow, failing-before/passing-after architecture regressions, and a gfx950 non-CUDA boundary, rather than a full reporter-environment reproduction.
The prepared ROCm stack showed an unrelated existing bf16 residual-gate bit-exact discrepancy (max_abs 0.03125); this change neither caused nor addresses it.
